title: A harness adapter is a small add-on, not a new model.
friendlyTitle: A small add-on is not a new model.
summary: On 20 November, Hugging Face said it trained a LoRA adapter for Qwen3.8-27B inside three agent harnesses: Pi, OpenCode, and Hermes Agent. On Terminal-Bench 2.1 with Pi, the lab says the base model scored 39 percent and used about 2,900 tokens a task. The Pi adapter scored 55 percent pass@1 and used about 1,500 tokens.
friendlySummary: On 20 November, Hugging Face said it trained a small add-on for the Qwen3.8-27B model, inside three agent tools: Pi, OpenCode, and Hermes Agent. On a coding test called Terminal-Bench 2.1, using Pi, the lab says the plain model scored 39 percent and used about 2,900 tokens per task. The Pi add-on scored 55 percent on the first try and used about 1,500 tokens.
whyItMatters: Those figures are the lab's, on its own tasks. The weights stay frozen. The adapter is trained for one harness and one kind of work. It is not a general upgrade, and it does not change the model you already have installed.
